RESEARCH_REQUIRED.message: Record the required research findings for task {task_id}.
RESEARCH_REQUIRED.hint:
WHAT: Research pass not recorded.
WHY: HAMMER demand read-only research (codebase file / online search) before BUILD.
HOW: Run 'hammer tasks modify {task_id} --research "<findings>"'. File path work for bulk note.
CONSEQUENCE: READY -> PROGRESSING stay blocked. NO research, NO submit.

BLOCKER_INCOMPLETE.message: Finish linked blocker {blocker} before entering PROGRESSING.
BLOCKER_INCOMPLETE.hint:
WHAT: Blocker {blocker} is not complete.
WHY: A blocked task can enter PROGRESSING only when every linked blocker is DONE or ARCHIVED.
HOW: Finish blocker {blocker}, or run 'hammer tasks unlink <blocked-task-id> {blocker}' if the dependency is no longer needed.
CONSEQUENCE: PROGRESSING stays blocked.

WORKTREE_NOT_FOUND.message: Create and mount the worktree for task {task_id}.
WORKTREE_NOT_FOUND.hint:
WHAT: Worktree not found for task {task_id}.
WHY: No dedicated worktree has been created for this task.
HOW: Run 'tasks mount {task_id}' to create and mount a worktree.
CONSEQUENCE: Task work cannot be isolated. CREATE WORKTREE.

WORKTREE_MAIN_DIVERGED.message: Reconcile local {default} ({local}) with origin/{default} ({remote}) for task {task_id}.
WORKTREE_MAIN_DIVERGED.hint:
WHAT: Local main and origin/main differ for task {task_id} branch '{branch}'.
WHY: Synchronizing from a diverged main would hide one side of the history.
HOW:
   1. Inspect: git log --left-right main...origin/main
   2. Reconcile local {default} with origin/{default}.
   3. Retry: ./hammer tasks mount {task_id}
CONSEQUENCE: Worktree synchronization blocked. RECONCILE MAIN.

WORKTREE_SYNC_CONFLICT.message: Resolve the worktree sync conflict for task {task_id} at {local_commit}: {paths}.
WORKTREE_SYNC_CONFLICT.hint:
WHAT: Task {task_id} branch '{branch}' conflicts with local {default} at {local_commit}.
WHY: Conflicting paths: {paths}.
HOW:
   1. Navigate: cd {worktree_path}
   2. Inspect: git status
   3. Resolve every conflicting path manually.
   4. Stage and commit the resolution: git add <paths> && git commit -m 'Resolve {default} sync conflict'
   5. Retry: ./hammer tasks mount {task_id}
CONSEQUENCE: Worktree synchronization blocked. RESOLVE CONFLICTS.

WORKTREE_LOCAL_WORK.message: Commit or stash local work for task {task_id} before synchronization: {paths}.
WORKTREE_LOCAL_WORK.hint:
WHAT: Task {task_id} branch '{branch}' has uncommitted local work.
WHY: Synchronizing could overwrite local files. Local {default}: {local_commit}. Paths: {paths}.
HOW:
   1. Navigate: cd {worktree_path}
   2. Inspect: git status
   3. Commit or stash the local work.
   4. Retry: ./hammer tasks mount {task_id}
CONSEQUENCE: Worktree synchronization blocked. PRESERVE LOCAL WORK.

REGRESSION_CHECK_NOT_PASSED.message: Complete the review and regression checks for task {task_id}.
REGRESSION_CHECK_NOT_PASSED.hint:
WHAT: Regression check not passed (Rc flag not set).
WHY: Pipeline governance requires a verifiable review.
HOW: 1. './hammer tasks audit {task_id}' to refresh the current patches.
     2. './hammer tasks review {task_id}' for EACH patch (repeat until all are marked reviewed).
     3. './hammer tasks modify {task_id} --reviewed "<short summary of what you read>"'.
     4. './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "<evidence>"'.
     5. './hammer tasks modify {task_id} --regression-check' to pass the gate.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. REVIEW EVERY PATCH.

UNFINISHED_CHECKBOXES.message: Complete every unchecked acceptance criterion for task {task_id}.
UNFINISHED_CHECKBOXES.hint:
WHAT: Task contain unfinished checkbox (- [ ]).
WHY: INCOMPLETE CRITERIA. HAMMER forbid promotion.
HOW: Merely marking checkboxes is not the goal. Confirm each subtask is genuinely complete, then use './hammer tasks show <id>' to verify criteria before retrying.
CONSEQUENCE: Pipeline halt. FIX CRITERIA.

PROOF_MISSING.hint:
WHAT: Verification proof missing for task {task_id}: {proof_path}.
WHY: Promotion requires a receipt-bound review of every current patch.
HOW: 1. Review every patch: './hammer tasks review {task_id}' (repeat until no patches remain).
     2. Finalize: './hammer tasks modify {task_id} --reviewed "<summary>"'.
     3. Bind proof: './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "<evidence>"'.
     4. Pass the gate: './hammer tasks modify {task_id} --regression-check'.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. COMPLETE REVIEW.

AUDIT_PATCH_MISSING.message: Generate the missing review patches for task {task_id}.
AUDIT_PATCH_MISSING.hint:
WHAT: Regression patches missing from {patches_dir}.
WHY: Patch generation failure or migration issue (patches not found in STAGING).
HOW: 1. Move task back to REVIEW using './hammer tasks move {task_id} REVIEW -y'.
     2. This will re-trigger the migration logic to move patches from REVIEW to STAGING.
     3. Then try moving to STAGING again.
CONSEQUENCE: Audit impossible. FIX PATH.

AUDIT_MISSING.message: Generate the missing cryptographic audit for task {task_id}.
AUDIT_MISSING.hint:
WHAT: Cryptographic audit missing: {audit_path}.
WHY: Code review required.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}'.
CONSEQUENCE: Audit chain broken. OBEY AUDIT.

AUDIT_MISMATCH.message: Refresh and review the stale audit artifacts for task {task_id}.
AUDIT_MISMATCH.hint:
WHAT: Audit mismatch. Code change since last audit.
HOW: 1. Re-review patch. 2. Run './hammer tasks audit {task_id}'. 3. Run './hammer tasks verify {task_id} --proof "..."'.
CONSEQUENCE: Integrity fail. LOCK CHAIN.

REVIEW_INCOMPLETE.message: Review the remaining patches for task {task_id}: {missing}.
REVIEW_INCOMPLETE.hint:
WHAT: Not every patch has been read: {missing}.
WHY: Each patch must be read via 'tasks review' before the review can be finalized.
HOW: {hint}
CONSEQUENCE: Cherry-picked review blocked. READ ALL.

REVIEW_SUMMARY_REQUIRED.message: Write the required review summary for task {task_id}.
REVIEW_SUMMARY_REQUIRED.hint:
WHAT: The review cannot be finalized without a written summary.
WHY: A summary proves the reviewer processed what they read.
HOW: {hint}
CONSEQUENCE: Review not finalized. WRITE SUMMARY.

REVIEW_SUMMARY_TOO_SHORT.message: Expand the review summary for task {task_id}.
REVIEW_SUMMARY_TOO_SHORT.hint:
WHAT: The review summary is too short.
WHY: A one-liner is not a review summary.
HOW: {hint}
CONSEQUENCE: Review not finalized. ADD DETAIL.

NO_PATCHES.message: Generate review patches for task {task_id} before reviewing them.
NO_PATCHES.hint:
WHAT: No review patches exist for task {task_id}.
WHY: Patch generation failed or artifacts were removed.
HOW: ./hammer tasks audit {task_id}
CONSEQUENCE: No diff to review. GENERATE FIRST.

PATCH_NOT_IN_TASK.message: Choose one of the available review patches for task {task_id}.
PATCH_NOT_IN_TASK.hint:
WHAT: Patch '{patch}' is not part of task {task_id}.
WHY: Only the task's own patches can be reviewed.
HOW: Available: {expected}
CONSEQUENCE: Wrong file. PICK FROM LIST.

REVIEW_STATE_REQUIRED.message: Move task {task_id} to REVIEW before reviewing patches.
REVIEW_STATE_REQUIRED.hint:
WHAT: Task {task_id} is not in REVIEW.
WHY: Patches exist only in REVIEW.
HOW: ./hammer tasks move {task_id} REVIEW
CONSEQUENCE: Nothing to review yet. MOVE FIRST.

STATE_REQUIRED.message: Move task {task_id} to {required_state} before running this command.
STATE_REQUIRED.hint:
WHAT: Task {task_id} must be in {required_state} state; it is currently in {current_state}.
WHY: PIPELINE GOVERNANCE VIOLATION.
HOW: Use './hammer tasks move <id> {required_state}'.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion blocked. OBEY PIPELINE.

NO_ACTIVE_TASK.message: Pass a task id to select the active task.
NO_ACTIVE_TASK.hint:
WHAT: No active task found.
WHY: Without an explicit id these commands would hit an arbitrary PROGRESSING task and mislabel its record. 
HOW: Pass the task id (see usage above).
CONSEQUENCE: Progress zero. SMASH WORK INTO MOTION.

INIT_REQUIRED.message: Initialize the task store before running this command.
INIT_REQUIRED.hint:
WHAT: Task not initialized.
WHY: NO WORKTREE FOUND. HAMMER need foundation.
HOW: Run './hammer tasks init'.
CONSEQUENCE: Hammer BLADE-LESS. FIX FOUNDATION.

MISSING_PARTS.hint:
WHAT: Mandatory task parameters are missing: {missing_parts}.
WHY: HAMMER command is incomplete.
HOW: Usage: tasks create '<title>' --story '<story>' --tech '<tech>' --criteria '<criteria>' --plan '<plan>'{issue_repro}.
CONSEQUENCE: Command aborted. FIX INSTRUCTION.

TOO_SHORT.hint:
WHAT: TOO SHORT: {too_short}.
WHY: INSUFFICIENT DETAIL. HAMMER demand substance.
HOW: Provide more detail.
CONSEQUENCE: Task rejected. FIX CONTENT.

VALIDATION_FAILED.message: Fix the failed {tool} validation check, then run ./hammer check all.
VALIDATION_FAILED.hint:
WHAT: Validation failed for {tool}: {msg}.
WHY: The code-quality gate is not satisfied.
HOW: Fix the validation failure shown above, then run './hammer check all' and retry the transition.
CONSEQUENCE: Task remains in its current state.

WORKTREE_MISSING_AUTO_DEMOTED.message: Restore the missing worktree for branch {branch}.
WORKTREE_MISSING_AUTO_DEMOTED.hint:
WHAT: Worktree '{branch}' missing, auto-demoted to PROGRESSING.
WHY: Task worktree was not found.
HOW: Run 'tasks mount {task_id}' to recreate the worktree.
CONSEQUENCE: Promotion halted. MOUNT WORKTREE.

NO_PROGRESS_UPDATE.message: Record a progress update in {progress_path} before continuing.
NO_PROGRESS_UPDATE.hint:
WHAT: No progress update detected.
WHY: PROGRESS STAGNATION. HAMMER demand record.
HOW: Update {progress_path} or {current_path} with progress, finding, mitigation.
CONSEQUENCE: Progress unknown. SUBMIT UPDATE.

CONTENT_REQUIRED.message: Add the required task content before continuing.
